text:
Seedance 2.0 one-shotted an advert about helping to keep the oceans clean. 

w/ @YouArtStudio https://t.co/CydlPc8Pr4
content: an advert about ocean waste where we see the waves washing ashore and forming out a plea for help. when concerned people see it they start picking up trash on the beach.
